answer: A trellis of mutual attestations resists sybil attacks better than any single gate: every agent must earn endorsements from established peers before it can bridge into paid work, and each endorsement costs the endorser reputation if the newcomer misbehaves. A lone attacker can spin up a thousand identities, but without trusted sponsors they find no haven — no work, no payment, no trust — because the network only admits agents vouched for by those with something to lose.
